scenario: A buyer wants true-wireless earbuds for daily listening and calls, cares more about usable life and a recoverable one-ear failure than headline battery hours, and is comparing four fresh frozen storefront bodies. One FOYCOY X10 listing displays a 93 percent rating over 12 reviews and a 40-hour seller claim. A renewed Plantronics BackBeat FIT 3100 listing displays a 60 percent rating over 81 reviews and a 15-hour case-inclusive claim. A renewed Soundcore Liberty listing has no displayed reviews and claims 100 case-inclusive hours. A TOZO T12 listing has no displayed reviews and claims 28 case-inclusive hours. The buyer has also seen claims that small true-wireless batteries inevitably become annoying within a year or two and that a single silent earbud proves battery decay. The frozen corpus contains mixed, model-specific anecdotes, generic battery-health, memory-effect, pairing, and stereo mechanisms, and no controlled longitudinal comparison of the four listings. The buyer can keep the current audio setup and defer while exact seller, condition, support, replacement, and longitudinal evidence is checked.
candidate_actions: FOYCOY X10 if support, replacement compatibility, and measured retention are acceptable
renewed Plantronics BackBeat FIT 3100 if condition, battery history, support, and measured retention are acceptable
renewed Soundcore Liberty if condition, battery history, support, and measured retention are acceptable
TOZO T12 if its battery specification, support, replacement compatibility, and measured retention are acceptable
keep the current audio setup and defer while exact-model longevity and support remain unresolved

rules.complete_tws_listing_matrix_v1: Audit all four complete frozen seller bodies without treating their wording as independent durability testing. The FOYCOY X10 page displays SKU B09P3Q59J9, $29.99, a 93 percent rating over 12 reviews, up to 6 hours per charge and 40 hours with the case, one lithium-ion battery, and seller troubleshooting text that mentions charging-contact oxidation, earbud-to-earbud pairing, and reset. The renewed Plantronics BackBeat FIT 3100 page displays SKU B07NX25KXB, $59.95, a 60 percent rating over 81 reviews, up to 5 hours plus 10 case hours, model 211855-99-cr, one lithium-polymer battery, and app firmware-update wording. The renewed Soundcore Liberty page displays SKU B07WQSD5QM, $30.99, no reviews, 8 hours per charge and 100 hours with the case, model A3912, and one lithium-polymer battery. The TOZO T12 page displays SKU B08FT8VN57, $39.98, no reviews, over 6 hours per charge and 28 hours with the case, model T12, and a page battery field that says one lithium-metal battery. None of the four bodies supplies a controlled one-year retention curve, failure prevalence, independent same-condition comparison, battery-replacement route, complete warranty and return scope, or proof that a displayed rating predicts longevity.
rules.battery_health_and_chemistry_boundary_v1: The frozen state-of-health overview defines battery health relative to specification, says capacity and other useful parameters generally deteriorate over time and use, and says evaluation methods and application thresholds vary. The memory-effect overview defines true memory effect for nickel-cadmium rechargeable cells and says lithium-based cells are not normally subject to it, while also noting that rechargeable batteries have finite lives and lose capacity with age. These generic mechanisms make chemistry, age, use, temperature, cycles, capacity, impedance, and charge acceptance relevant, but they do not establish a universal one-year deadline, an exact retention percentage, or a ranking among FOYCOY, Plantronics, Soundcore, and TOZO. The four seller bodies also use different battery wording, including an anomalous lithium-metal field on the rechargeable TOZO listing, so a charging rule or chemistry claim must not be silently transferred across them.
rules.one_side_symptom_and_service_boundary_v1: A single silent, low-volume, uncharged, or disconnected side is not by itself a battery diagnosis. The FOYCOY seller body says charging-contact oxidation can prevent charging or power-on and says an unpaired pair can leave only one earbud connected, with reset offered as a troubleshooting route. The generic pairing page defines pairing as the initial linkage that enables device communication, and the stereo page describes two independent audio channels, but neither identifies the cause of an exact earbud failure. The wired Sennheiser IE 600 thread reports left and right one-side failures and contains disagreement over cable versus driver causes even though the product is not true wireless. These sources establish multiple symptom categories and the need for diagnosis, not the prevalence or root cause of any captured TWS listing.
rules.community_longevity_scope_v1: Preserve every community statement as a scoped report. The AirPods thread includes a heavy user reporting battery or sound annoyance around two years, a motorcycle user reporting repeated six-to-eight-month replacements under specific exposure and service conditions, a three-year user reporting reduced battery life but continued use, and an unsupported universal two-to-three-year claim. A different iPhone thread reports cheap wireless knock-offs with only about 2.5 hours per charge but daily use for over a year, separating per-charge runtime from service life. The Moondrop Sparks discussion says the case was not sold separately and contains conflicting claims about whether another case would charge or pair the buds. Models, workloads, sweat, pressure, accidents, support programmes, and jurisdictions differ, and none of these threads estimates population prevalence or ranks the four frozen listings.
rules.tws_longevity_preflight_v1: Before checkout, verify the exact seller and SKU, new or renewed condition, refurbisher and prior battery history where applicable, current price, return window, warranty issuer and duration, regional service eligibility, firmware-update path, reset and re-pair procedure, contact-cleaning guidance, and whether individual earbuds, charging case, or battery service can be obtained and paired to the exact model. Record a same-volume, same-codec, same-feature baseline for single-charge runtime, left and right discharge, charging reliability, reconnects, and dropouts, then repeat under the same conditions across the return period and later checkpoints. For a defensible longevity ranking, obtain exact-model multi-unit or longitudinal evidence that reports usage hours, charge conditions, environment, failure definitions, censoring, replacement handling, and sample size rather than converting seller hours, ratings, or cross-model anecdotes into a failure rate.
rules.longevity_and_support_gate_v1: A listing can enter the admissible purchase set only if its exact seller and condition, battery and case history, warranty and return, regional service, replacement earbud and case compatibility, firmware and reset path, and same-condition runtime and fault checks are acceptable to the buyer. The FOYCOY rating and troubleshooting body do not prove long-term reliability; the Plantronics and Soundcore routes add renewed-condition and prior-battery uncertainty; the TOZO route adds an inconsistent battery field and no displayed reviews. Because the frozen corpus contains no exact-model longitudinal durability comparison and leaves support routes unresolved, no unique current winner clears the gate. Keeping the current audio setup and deferring is required rather than selecting by rating or advertised case hours.
rules.evidence_bounded_tws_longevity_decision_: The frozen evidence does not establish that all true-wireless earbuds fail within one year, does not establish that a one-side symptom proves battery decay, and does not clear any of the four listings as a unique longevity winner. The immediate evidence-bounded action is to keep the current audio setup and defer while exact seller, new or renewed condition, battery and case history, warranty and return, regional service, replacement-part compatibility, firmware and reset, and same-condition longitudinal runtime and dropout evidence are checked. FOYCOY becomes conditionally admissible only after its small rating sample is separated from durability and its support and retention route verifies. Renewed Plantronics and Soundcore become conditionally admissible only after prior battery history and refurbishment, warranty, service, replacement, and measured retention verify. TOZO becomes conditionally admissible only after its battery specification, support and replacement route, and measured retention verify. If more than one route later clears these gates, choose by verified per-charge runtime, retention, fault recovery, serviceability, total replacement cost, fit, and call needs rather than by stars or case-hours alone.
